_readme: Copy to scripts/staff-logins.config.json (gitignored) and fill in real values there.
NEVER put a real address or password in THIS file — it is committed.
Alternatively set STAFF_LOGINS_CONFIG to this JSON as a string and skip the file.
newPassword must be at least 12 characters; the script refuses anything shorter.
currentEmail must match an existing public.staff row (case-insensitive) that has a user_id.
